closed_class: Regularized same-subgroup n-Miller translation quotients, constant products, shift ratios, Frobenius norms and norm-one extraction.
main_identity: f_(n,P)(S+Q)/f_(n,P)(S)=h_(P,Q)(S)^n for P,Q in one cyclic n-subgroup.
twist_collapse: The unique n-th root of the trace-zero norm-one quotient is a Mobius function of x(Q-P/2).
claim_boundary: No unrestricted circuit lower bound, parity oracle, sub-root evaluator, or sub-square-root ECDLP algorithm is claimed.
